k_means_states.summary: k-means clusters of the standardised training bars; each cluster reads out its training up-rate and mean move.
k_means_states.implementationNote: Bridge: Lloyd's k-means on the training rows' standardised features (no labels); a bar takes its nearest centroid and P(up) = the state's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Price: the cluster's shrunk mean scaled move. Differs from the spec: clusters carry no direction until the readout gives them one. Expect: P(up) near the base rate unless clusters separate persistent regimes.

initialization_count.label: Restarts
initialization_count.description: k-means++ restarts; the one with the lowest within-cluster sum of squares is kept.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

gaussian_mixture_states.summary: A Gaussian mixture fitted by EM on the standardised training bars; a bar's soft membership weights each component's training up-rate.
gaussian_mixture_states.implementationNote: Bridge: a Gaussian mixture fitted by EM on standardised training rows (no labels); P(up) = sum over components of the bar's posterior responsibility times the component's responsibility-weighted Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Price: the same sum over mean scaled moves. Differs from the spec: direction comes only from the readout. Expect: soft, near-base-rate probabilities.

component_count.label: Components
component_count.description: How many Gaussian components the mixture has.

covariance_structure.label: Covariance structure
covariance_structure.description: Each component's covariance: full (any ellipsoid) or diagonal (axis-aligned).

covariance_regularization.label: Covariance regularization
covariance_regularization.description: Added to every covariance diagonal so a component never collapses onto a few bars.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

hierarchical_clustering_states.summary: Agglomerative (bottom-up merges) or divisive (bisecting) clustering of spread training bars, cut at a cluster count; new bars vote by their nearest fitted bars.
hierarchical_clustering_states.implementationNote: Bridge: agglomerative linkage or divisive bisecting k-means on up to Maximum fit rows spread training rows, cut at Clusters; a new bar's cluster shares are a distance-weighted vote of its nearest fitted rows, and P(up) = those shares times each cluster's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: fitted on a subsample; new bars take their nearest clusters (the method has no predict). Expect: near-base-rate probabilities.

cluster_count.label: Clusters
cluster_count.description: Where the merge tree is cut: how many clusters remain.

hierarchy_direction.label: Direction
hierarchy_direction.description: Agglomerative merges bars bottom-up; divisive splits the data top-down (bisecting k-means).

linkage_rule.label: Linkage
linkage_rule.description: How agglomerative merging measures the distance between two clusters (Ward: least added variance).

maximum_fit_rows.label: Maximum fit rows
maximum_fit_rows.description: At most this many training rows, spread evenly over the training span, enter the clustering (its cost grows with the square of the row count).

neighbor_count.label: Extension neighbours
neighbor_count.description: A new bar's cluster is a distance-weighted vote of this many nearest fitted bars.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

density_clustering_states.summary: Density clusters of the training bars on their leading principal components, plus a noise state for isolated bars.
density_clustering_states.implementationNote: Bridge: DBSCAN on the training rows' leading principal components, radius from the k-distance curve; a bar takes the cluster of its nearest core point within the radius, else the noise state, and P(up) = the state's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: density needs few dimensions, so it runs on principal components. Expect: few clusters plus noise; probabilities near the base rate.

principal_component_count.label: Principal components
principal_component_count.description: DBSCAN runs on this many leading principal components of the standardised training rows (whitened); 0 uses every standardised feature.

neighborhood_radius_quantile.label: Radius quantile
neighborhood_radius_quantile.description: The neighbourhood radius is this quantile of the training rows' distance to their k-th neighbour.

core_point_share.label: Core point share
core_point_share.description: A core point needs this share of the fitted rows inside its radius (at least twice the dimension).

maximum_fit_rows.label: Maximum fit rows
maximum_fit_rows.description: At most this many training rows, spread evenly over the training span, enter the density clustering (its cost grows with the square of the row count).

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

mean_shift_states.summary: Modes of the training bars' kernel density on their leading principal components; each mode reads out its training up-rate.
mean_shift_states.implementationNote: Bridge: mean shift finds the density modes of spread training rows on their leading principal components; a bar takes its nearest mode (modes under Minimum state share are merged into one state), and P(up) = the state's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: the mode count is capped by the merge. Expect: a handful of modes; probabilities near the base rate.

principal_component_count.label: Principal components
principal_component_count.description: Mean shift runs on this many leading principal components of the standardised training rows (whitened); 0 uses every standardised feature.

bandwidth_quantile.label: Bandwidth quantile
bandwidth_quantile.description: The kernel bandwidth is this quantile of the fitted rows' pairwise distances.

minimum_state_share.label: Minimum state share
minimum_state_share.description: A mode holding less than this share of the fitted rows is merged into one 'other' state.

maximum_fit_rows.label: Maximum fit rows
maximum_fit_rows.description: At most this many training rows, spread evenly over the training span, enter mean shift (its cost grows with the square of the row count).

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

affinity_propagation_states.summary: Exemplar bars chosen by message passing over the training bars' similarities; a bar reads out its nearest exemplar's up-rate.
affinity_propagation_states.implementationNote: Bridge: affinity propagation (responsibility and availability messages over negative squared distances) on up to Maximum fit rows spread training rows; a bar takes its nearest exemplar, and P(up) = the state's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: fitted on a subsample (quadratic in rows); new bars take their nearest exemplar. Expect: many small states; probabilities near the base rate.

preference_percentile.label: Preference percentile
preference_percentile.description: Each bar's self-preference is this percentile of the similarities: lower gives fewer exemplars.

damping.label: Damping
damping.description: How much of the previous message each update keeps (steadies convergence).

maximum_fit_rows.label: Maximum fit rows
maximum_fit_rows.description: At most this many training rows, spread evenly over the training span, enter affinity propagation (its cost grows with the square of the row count).

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

spectral_clustering_states.summary: Clusters of the nearest-neighbour graph of spread training bars, found in the eigenvectors of its Laplacian; new bars vote by their nearest fitted bars.
spectral_clustering_states.implementationNote: Bridge: spectral clustering (normalised Laplacian of the nearest-neighbour graph) on up to Maximum fit rows spread training rows; a new bar's cluster shares are a distance-weighted vote of its nearest fitted rows, and P(up) = those shares times each cluster's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: fitted on a subsample; new bars take their nearest clusters. Expect: probabilities near the base rate.

cluster_count.label: Clusters
cluster_count.description: How many clusters the spectral embedding is cut into.

affinity_neighbor_count.label: Graph neighbours
affinity_neighbor_count.description: Each fitted bar is linked to this many nearest bars in the affinity graph.

maximum_fit_rows.label: Maximum fit rows
maximum_fit_rows.description: At most this many training rows, spread evenly over the training span, enter spectral clustering (its cost grows with the square of the row count).

neighbor_count.label: Extension neighbours
neighbor_count.description: A new bar's cluster is a distance-weighted vote of this many nearest fitted bars.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

self_organizing_map.summary: A Kohonen grid of prototypes trained by competitive learning on the training bars; a bar reads out its best-matching cell, smoothed over neighbouring cells.
self_organizing_map.implementationNote: Bridge: a MiniSom grid trained on the standardised training rows (Gaussian neighbourhood, decaying step, PCA start); a bar's state is its best-matching cell, whose training up-rate pools neighbouring cells with a Gaussian of Topology smoothing cells. Price: the pooled mean scaled move. Differs from the spec: the map's topology is used only for that pooling. Expect: near-base-rate probabilities.

grid_rows.label: Grid rows
grid_rows.description: Rows of the map's grid of cells.

grid_columns.label: Grid columns
grid_columns.description: Columns of the map's grid of cells.

neighborhood_width.label: Neighbourhood width
neighborhood_width.description: The initial width (in cells) of the Gaussian that drags a winner's neighbours along.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: The initial step toward each training bar; it decays over training.

iteration_count.label: Training updates
iteration_count.description: How many single-bar updates train the map.

topology_smoothing.label: Topology smoothing
topology_smoothing.description: The readout pools each cell's evidence with its grid neighbours over this many cells (0: none).

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

isolation_forest_states.summary: How easily random trees isolate a bar, binned at training quantiles; each bin reads out what followed such bars in training.
isolation_forest_states.implementationNote: Bridge: isolation-forest path length (the anomaly score) binned at training quantiles, P(up) = the state's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: the score has no direction, so each bin is split by the side of the first principal axis (unsupervised, switchable off), which mostly sets up or down; the bin sets how strongly. Expect: near the base rate.

tree_count.label: Trees
tree_count.description: How many random isolation trees average the path length.

samples_per_tree.label: Samples per tree
samples_per_tree.description: Training bars drawn to grow each isolation tree.

bin_count.label: Score bins
bin_count.description: The anomaly score is cut into this many bins at the training rows' quantiles.

principal_axis_split.label: Split bins by the first principal axis
principal_axis_split.description: Split every score bin by the side of the training median along the training rows' first principal axis (an unsupervised half-space), so the readout can carry a direction.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

local_outlier_factor_states.summary: A bar's local density against its nearest training bars (novelty mode), binned at training quantiles; each bin reads out what followed such bars.
local_outlier_factor_states.implementationNote: Bridge: the local outlier factor of a bar against its nearest fitted training rows (novelty mode, never test rows) binned at training quantiles, P(up) = the state's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: the score has no direction, so each bin is split by the side of the first principal axis (unsupervised, switchable off), which mostly sets up or down; the bin sets how strongly. Expect: near the base rate.

neighbor_count.label: Neighbours
neighbor_count.description: The local density is measured over this many nearest training bars.

maximum_fit_rows.label: Maximum fit rows
maximum_fit_rows.description: At most this many training rows, spread evenly over the training span, enter the neighbour set (its cost grows with the square of the row count).

bin_count.label: Score bins
bin_count.description: The anomaly score is cut into this many bins at the training rows' quantiles.

principal_axis_split.label: Split bins by the first principal axis
principal_axis_split.description: Split every score bin by the side of the training median along the training rows' first principal axis (an unsupervised half-space), so the readout can carry a direction.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

one_class_svm_states.summary: The RBF one-class SVM's normality score of a bar, binned at training quantiles; each bin reads out what followed such bars.
one_class_svm_states.implementationNote: Bridge: the RBF one-class SVM decision value (fitted on spread training rows) binned at training quantiles, P(up) = the state's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: the score has no direction, so each bin is split by the side of the first principal axis (unsupervised, switchable off), which mostly sets up or down; the bin sets how strongly. Expect: near the base rate.

outlier_share.label: Outlier share
outlier_share.description: nu: an upper bound on the share of training bars left outside the boundary.

kernel_width_scale.label: Kernel width scale
kernel_width_scale.description: Multiplies the RBF kernel's inverse width 1 / (features x variance): larger is tighter.

maximum_fit_rows.label: Maximum fit rows
maximum_fit_rows.description: At most this many training rows, spread evenly over the training span, enter the SVM (its cost grows with the square of the row count).

bin_count.label: Score bins
bin_count.description: The anomaly score is cut into this many bins at the training rows' quantiles.

principal_axis_split.label: Split bins by the first principal axis
principal_axis_split.description: Split every score bin by the side of the training median along the training rows' first principal axis (an unsupervised half-space), so the readout can carry a direction.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

robust_covariance_states.summary: The Mahalanobis distance of a bar from the minimum-covariance-determinant centre, binned at training quantiles; each bin reads out what followed such bars.
robust_covariance_states.implementationNote: Bridge: squared Mahalanobis distance to the minimum covariance determinant fit of the training rows, binned at training quantiles, P(up) = the state's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Differs from the spec: the score has no direction, so each bin is split by the side of the first principal axis (unsupervised, switchable off), which mostly sets up or down; the bin sets how strongly. Expect: near the base rate.

support_fraction.label: Support fraction
support_fraction.description: The share of training bars the robust estimate is fitted on (the rest are treated as outliers).

maximum_fit_rows.label: Maximum fit rows
maximum_fit_rows.description: At most this many training rows, spread evenly over the training span, enter the robust estimate (its cost grows with the square of the row count).

bin_count.label: Score bins
bin_count.description: The anomaly score is cut into this many bins at the training rows' quantiles.

principal_axis_split.label: Split bins by the first principal axis
principal_axis_split.description: Split every score bin by the side of the training median along the training rows' first principal axis (an unsupervised half-space), so the readout can carry a direction.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

mixture_model_regimes.summary: Class-conditional Gaussian mixtures of up and down training bars joined by Bayes' rule, or one mixture of regimes read out by their up-rates.
mixture_model_regimes.implementationNote: Bridge: class-conditional mode fits a Gaussian mixture to up and one to down training rows (standardised features or their principal components); P(up|x) = pi_up f_up / (pi_up f_up + pi_down f_down), then a logistic curve on validation. Regime mode reads one mixture out by up-rates. Differs from the spec: the DPM prior is the Dirichlet process key. Expect: over-confident densities tamed by the curve.

mixture_mode.label: Mode
mixture_mode.description: class_conditional: one mixture per outcome and Bayes' rule; regime_posterior: one mixture of regimes read out by their up-rates.

component_count.label: Components
component_count.description: Gaussian components per mixture (per class in class-conditional mode).

covariance_structure.label: Covariance structure
covariance_structure.description: Each component's covariance: full (any ellipsoid) or diagonal (axis-aligned).

covariance_regularization.label: Covariance regularization
covariance_regularization.description: Added to every covariance diagonal so a component never collapses onto a few bars.

principal_component_count.label: Principal components
principal_component_count.description: The mixture runs on this many leading principal components of the standardised training rows (whitened); 0 uses every standardised feature.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

dirichlet_process_regimes.summary: A truncated stick-breaking Dirichlet-process mixture of the training bars that decides how many regimes it needs; each regime reads out its up-rate.
dirichlet_process_regimes.implementationNote: Bridge: a Dirichlet-process Gaussian mixture (stick-breaking, truncated variational inference) on standardised training rows infers how many regimes carry weight; P(up) = sum over regimes of the bar's responsibility times the regime's Beta-smoothed training up-rate. Price: the same sum over mean scaled moves. Differs from the spec: variational, not Gibbs, and truncated at Truncation level. Expect: a few regimes; probabilities near the base rate.

truncation_level.label: Truncation level
truncation_level.description: The most components the stick-breaking prior may use; unused ones keep near-zero weight.

concentration.label: Concentration
concentration.description: The Dirichlet process's alpha: larger opens new regimes more readily.

covariance_structure.label: Covariance structure
covariance_structure.description: Each component's covariance: full (any ellipsoid) or diagonal (axis-aligned).

covariance_regularization.label: Covariance regularization
covariance_regularization.description: Added to every covariance diagonal so a component never collapses onto a few bars.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

hidden_markov_regimes.summary: A Gaussian hidden Markov model of the training span's bars; each bar's forward-filtered state weights the states' training up-rates.
hidden_markov_regimes.implementationNote: Bridge: a diagonal Gaussian HMM fitted by Baum-Welch on the training span (leading principal components); P(up) = sum over states of the forward-filtered probability at the bar times the state's training up-rate weighted by filtered probabilities. Differs from the spec: forward filter only, never the smoother. Expect: regime persistence is the whole edge.

state_count.label: Hidden states
state_count.description: How many hidden market states the chain moves between.

iteration_count.label: Baum-Welch iterations
iteration_count.description: EM passes over the training span.

principal_component_count.label: Principal components
principal_component_count.description: The emission model runs on this many leading principal components of the standardised training rows (whitened); 0 uses every standardised feature.

readout_prior_strength.label: Readout prior strength
readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.

scenario_analysis.summary: Historical scenarios found in the training bars, each with a driver table and an outcome table; today's bar is weighted across scenarios by how much it resembles each.
scenario_analysis.implementationNote: Bridge: scenarios are Gaussian-mixture components on the training rows' leading principal components, their count chosen by BIC; each keeps a driver table and an outcome table (up-rate, scaled-move quantiles); P(up) = sum of scenario weights times up-rates, then a logistic curve on validation. Differs from the spec: scenarios are historical, not hand-written. Expect: near the base rate.

scenario_count.label: Most scenarios
scenario_count.description: BIC picks the scenario count between 2 and this.

covariance_structure.label: Covariance structure
covariance_structure.description: Each component's covariance: full (any ellipsoid) or diagonal (axis-aligned).

covariance_regularization.label: Covariance regularization
covariance_regularization.description: Added to every covariance diagonal so a component never collapses onto a few bars.

principal_component_count.label: Principal components
principal_component_count.description: The scenario mixture runs on this many leading principal components of the standardised training rows (whitened); 0 uses every standardised feature.

readout_prior_strength.description: How many pseudo-bars at the training base rate each state's up-rate (or mean move) is shrunk toward; a rarely visited state reads close to the base rate.
